reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the front, which is a nice touch, but there are zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal, and I already reorder from brands I know. At about $1 a serving I would not gamble on an unknown name when I have tried three magnesiums this year.
objection: A brand with no reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to the company's own lab report is not the same as a third party certifying it, and I have no one else's experience to go on.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal, or a few hundred verified reviews with a solid rating, or a lower price for a first box.
